rationale: The reviewer found that SelectKBest was run on all 60 samples before CV, and showed with a permuted-label null that this leakage alone gives near-perfect AUROC. Moving selection inside the CV folds gave AUROC 0.42–0.58 (mean about 0.51), which roughly matches the key's ~0.58, and they also flagged the missing independent cohort. Their other points (missing baselines, possible confounding) are generic rather than new substantive flaws.
